description: Vercel cloud platform for deploying and scaling web applications with a comprehensive REST API and SDKs.
auth_notes: Uses Vercel Access Tokens passed as a Bearer token in the Authorization header for personal/team resource access, and OAuth2 for public marketplace integrations.
credential_notes: Any developer can sign up for a free Hobby plan account and instantly generate personal access tokens directly from their account settings.
api_notes: Comprehensive REST API covering deployments, domains, projects, environment variables, storage, teams, webhooks, and more.
mcp_notes: Vercel publishes official Model Context Protocol (MCP) features and documentation via its platform tools (Vercel MCP).
rationale: Vercel provides a fully documented public REST API accessible immediately using self-serve personal access tokens generated on a free account.

evidence.note: Describes using Vercel Access Tokens via Bearer token authorization for the REST API.
GitHub repository documentation outlining how developers can create personal access tokens from their Vercel account settings for API and CLI usage.
Lists broad REST API endpoint groups across deployments, projects, domains, and environment configurations.
References Vercel MCP capabilities within the documentation layout.
